Title: Mount Lyell and the Lyell Glacier
Content: The photographs below show the Lyell Glacier in `text(1901)` and in `text(2011)`. The Lyell Glacier is located in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California within Yosemite National Park. Glaciers are sensitive indicators of climatic changes.
